notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Nether Traitor
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability granted by Elven Chorus by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the Graveborn token
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability granted by Elven Chorus by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
